interview.name: Eli
interview.answer: The repair drive’s time and location aren’t specified in the notes yet.

reflections: Eli tends to organize group tasks by simplifying the process and making responsibilities explicit.
Opal is helpful in a practical support role, especially for logistics like location and timing.

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m glad you brought it up; I’ve been meaning to check what still needs doing.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll write down the remaining fixes, and we can go through them one by one. Then we’ll know exactly what needs doing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Opal: I don’t have anything noted yet, but I can help track where the repair drive is happening. Want me to check the location details with you?
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Eli: Yes, please—let’s keep it simple. Tell me where it’s happening and what time to be there.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Opal: It’s happening at the community center parking lot, and be there by 10:00 AM.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll write down the remaining fixes, and we can go through them one by one. Then we’ll know exactly what needs doing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli — that’ll make it easier to tackle the rest one by one. I’ll be here when you’re ready to go through the list.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Good — I’ll start the list now, and we can go through it step by step.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll write down the remaining fixes, and we can go through them one by one. Then we’ll know exactly what needs doing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: That works for me — late morning is best, and I still need the exact list of tools and replacement parts before I can help much. Let’s pin down the supplies first, then we can go through the fixes one by one.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Good idea — I’ll make a clean list of the tools and parts first, then we can match them to each fix one by one.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive too—just tell me the time and what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: Good idea — I’ll make a clean list of the tools and parts first, then we can match them to each fix one by one.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Dane: Sounds good — send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll help match the tools and parts to each fix.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: Good, let’s keep it simple: tell me the time, the location, and what still needs fixing. Then I can help get the list sorted.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, but I can swing by and get the time and location, plus what’s left to fix. Then I’ll pass it along so you can help sort the list.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: That works for me, Nell. Once you have the time, location, and the fix list, send it over and I’ll help sort it out.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Faye: Thanks — send me the repair drive details when you can, and I’ll coordinate around school pickup once I have them.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Eli: I can do that — just send me the time, place, and list of repairs, and I’ll keep to the plan.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Faye: Sure — I’ll send you the time, place, and repair list, and then I can work around school pickup.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Eli: That’d be great, Mina — send me the latest list and I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Kira: So it’s still on, right? I just need a clear yes on whether the repair drive is happening and what time works best.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. I’ll let you know if anything shifts.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive. If you hear what we still need, send it my way.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll send over anything I hear that’s still needed so we can keep it organized.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: Thanks for confirming — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll wait for the exact time and details.
events.speaker: Cleo
